messages:
Renee: heads-up: planning a cautious rollout for v3q2-int4 (repack) — want to lock canary gates, especially slice-level rules
Tomas: good call. what's the seed plan?
Renee: 2% longdoc, 1% shortanswers, 2% multimodal-text (low traffic) -> target 12% if stable in two 25m windows
Nadia: suggest these auto-fallback rules: global MRR drop > 2.5% OR any seeded slice hallucination delta > 0.6pp with >=400 samples OR p99 latency up > 35%
Tomas: add a token-level soft metric: average token perplexity increase > 1.2x should warn but not auto-fallback
Renee: agreed. also we should exclude transient small-sample blips: require sliding aggregation of 20m across slices for global rules
Renee: draft config snippet:
```
monitor_window_mins: 25
ramp_steps: [2,6,12]
min_samples_global: 4000
min_samples_slice: 400
mrr_relative_drop_pct: 2.5
slice_halluc_delta_pp: 0.6
p99_latency_increase_pct: 35
token_perplexity_multiplier: 1.2
soft_alerts: {"mrr":1.0, "perplexity":1.1}
allow_slice_override: true
```
Nadia: allow_slice_override=true means slice breach triggers immediate rollback, right?
Renee: yes, only for seeded slices with >=min_samples_slice. prevents slow bleed into production from a single broken slice
canary-bot: Canary started at 1723689040 for v3q2-int4 @ 2% longdoc/1% shortanswers/2% multimodal-text
Tomas: 10m smoke: MRR +0.3%, halluc -0.01pp, p99 +2%
eval-bot: running queued 500 high-risk prompt pass now (longdoc-heavy)
eval-bot: 500 high-risk done: hallucination increase on that set +0.7pp (0.7 -> 1.4), formatting hallucination dominant
Nadia: hmmm that's above 0.6pp on that set, but slice sample=500 which meets threshold. Do we auto-fallback? per config yes
Renee: check aggregate counts: global aggregated samples ~1300, global halluc +0.25pp only
Tomas: our previous stance was to allow slice-level immediate rollback — I support auto-fallback here
canary-bot: Auto-fallback executed at 1723689195. Reverted to baseline. Reason: seeded_slice(longdoc) hallucination_delta_pp=+0.70 (samples=512)
Renee: filing artifact dump and tag for evals: s3://redwood-canary-logs/1723689012-v3q2-dump.json
Nadia: capture the top 50 tokens where model diverged vs baseline — helps pinpoint quant rounding issues
Tomas: also record token perplexity delta heatmap. If it's not broad, could be a few prompt patterns to sanitize
eval-bot: quick diff summary attached in ticket #ML-1287: higher propensity for hallucinated citations on longlist items, appears to correlate with compressed kv-cache warm-start
Renee: next steps agreed in thread: 1) run a no-repack calibration with increased kv-warmup, 2) shrink initial canary to 1% per-slice and extend monitoring to 30m, 3) patch prompt sanitization for known runcase patterns, 4) re-run with slice-level gates on
Tomas: will open follow-up PR for canary config changes and schedule reattempt after calibration artifacts land
Nadia: thanks team. closing this canary thread — we avoided larger exposure. :white_check_mark:
